children: The US Treasury's auction on Wednesday of $16 billion in 20-year bonds yielded a high rate of 5.459%, with 70.87% of bids awarded at that rate, according to Treasury data.
The 20-year bond auction saw a bid-to-cover ratio, a measure of demand, of 2.63.
